enforcement: risk == 5 cannot be directly implemented from the kit

levels.1: isolated cleanup with direct tests and trivial rollback
levels.2: local internal refactor with clear tests
levels.3: multi-file or multi-module internal change requiring approved packet
levels.4: public contract, dependency, runtime integration, migration, generated code, build, release, or performance-sensitive change requiring explicit human approval
levels.5: architectural, security, data model, irreversible, cross-system, or behavior-changing work requiring RFC/ADR; no direct implementation from kit

priority_rule: Priority may rank work, but priority never overrides risk.
